children: Weave announced early termination of the HSR waiting period for its pending acquisition by Francisco Partners affiliates and expects closing in Q4 2026.
Early termination of the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period granted, satisfying a closing condition for the merger.
Transaction: merger of Merger Sub into the company to make Weave a wholly owned subsidiary of Willow Parent.
Merger expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary conditions including stockholder approval.
Company to file definitive proxy and call a special meeting of stockholders to obtain approval for the transaction.
